source: OpenStreetMap community database via Overpass API
transformations: lat/lon keys reordered to GeoJSON lon/lat without rounding
Explicit area=yes ways represented as Polygon only if their source node ring is closed
One multipolygon relation assembled from its two matching outer member traces; no artificial segments inserted
Subsets select complete original geometries by bbox intersection; no spatial clipping/simplification/buffer
Source geometry copied verbatim; no widths or construction dates inferred
limits: Not an authoritative surveyed inventory, scientific damage polygon, current inspection or cadastral boundary
OSM timestamps describe mapping edits/database snapshots, not image capture or construction
A LineString is a mapped axis/trace, not a full physical footprint
Neither completeness nor positional accuracy has been independently established
Only one mapped groyne occurs in broad query; no groyne in Celestun–Chabihau subset; does not replace published359 point inventory
Some queried piers may be inland/lagoon structures, and broadbbox may contain areas outside Yucatan state; spatial subset is operational only
